text:
alex_m: Heads-up: node gpu-rack3-42 showing repeated Xid 13 and big ECC correctable spikes, starting ~02:35 UTC. Suspect flaky card, opening triage.

alex_m: Logs snippet: ```Mar 23 02:34:11 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 13, GPU has fallen off the bus
Mar 23 02:34:11 kernel: nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: GPU reported ECC errors: correctable=23812, uncorrectable=0```

priya_ops: Which GPU serial/slot? We should start an RMA if hw failure likely. Are you able to drain the node? :eyes:

alex_m: Slot 0, serial GPU-XYZ12345, vendor SN 2109-ABCD. Ran `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.errors.corrected --format=csv` shows 23812 correctable in last day. Kernel Xid 13 recurs every 10-20m.

marta_hw: Please open vendor ticket and request depot swap. Node is in eu-west-1 (Amsterdam) so need EU depot. Confirm warranty and send serial + `lspci -vvv` output + photos of card + host pci slot.

alex_m: Opened ticket INC-8942 with vendor_support. Pasted serials, `lspci` output, and logs. Vendor asked for PCI traces and PSUs history — sent. RMA request submitted.

vendor_support: RMA created: RMA-2026-DL-7721. Swap type: depot swap. Replacement will be shipped from NL depot. Need ship-from address, VAT/CN info for customs. Tracking provided once dispatched.

priya_ops: We need a maintenance window to drain and replace. Can we do rolling drain tonight 02:00 UTC? Cluster capacity check: we can spare one GPU node but need to coordinate pod evictions.

tj_oncall: I can take the drain. Use: `kubectl cordon gpu-rack3-42` then `kubectl drain gpu-rack3-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300 --timeout=10m`. I'll watch eviction state.

alex_m: Starting cordon at 1760895400. Evictions in progress. One pod failed to reschedule due to local model cache mount. Cleared cache and retried; eviction succeeded.

marta_hw: For depot swap logistics: vendor can do pre-staged replacement (send replacement first, we ship failed unit back). Confirm if finance will cover courier/duties (~€110-150 for cross-border express). Warranty should cover part but not courier.

priya_ops: Finance: mark as warranty RMA but we may be charged for courier. I'll open a ticket with finance to confirm cost center. Keep RMA ticket updated with ship-from address.

vendor_support: Dispatch update: replacement shipped from NL depot. Carrier: FedEx Express. Tracking: FEDEXNL123456789. Customs docs CNTR-2026-556 attached to RMA. ETA to site: 2026-03-23 09:00 CET. Technician will require onsite signing for depot swap.

alex_m: Replacement arrived, tech swapped card at ~12:30 CET. Performed quick POST and `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,serial --format=csv` shows new serial GPU-NEW98765. Ran 1-hour burn-in: `stress-ng --gpu 1 --timeout 3600s` + monitoring, no Xid/ECC events so far. Reenabled scheduling.

marta_hw: Added failed unit GPU-XYZ12345 to asset tracker as RMA-failed / awaiting return-to-vendor. Keep ticket open until vendor confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:

vendor_support: Confirmed: RMA-2026-DL-7721 status changed to "Shipped replacement - awaiting return". Please drop failed unit to courier within 5 business days using pre-paid label in the portal.

priya_ops: Follow-up actions: 1) Add ECC alert rule to catch fast spikes, suggested threshold `gpu.ecc.correctable >= 10000 over 24h` -> create auto-ticket to vendor_bot. 2) Update runbook with depot-swap checklist (photos, customs, finance charge codes).

tj_oncall: Thx. Also recommend adding a transient drain script to evict pods that rely on local caches before draining (avoid blocked evictions). I'll draft a tiny helper in ops-scripts.

alex_m: Closing monitoring window after 48h. No further Xid/ECC anomalies. Will mark thread resolved once vendor confirms return of faulty card. Thanks all. :tada:

marta_hw: Vendor confirmed receipt of failed unit on 2026-03-28. RMA closed as 'replaced'. Asset record updated to 'returned; vendor replaced'.

priya_ops: Filing a short postmortem note in #postmortems per process — include timeline, cost estimate (~€130 courier), and remediation (alert + drain helper).

alex_m: Good job everyone. Leaving the alert tweak PR for review.
